text: Minor degree requirement profile for Energy Minor Undergraduate Program (ENERG-MINOR), admit/curriculum term Fall 2022-2023 (202201). Total minimum SU credits: 21. Total minimum ECTS: None. Sections: core electives (15 SU, 22 courses in pool), area electives (6 SU, 23 courses in pool). Diploma area advisors: Murat Kaya.

The core electives pool for the Energy Minor Undergraduate Program (ENERG-MINOR), admit/curriculum term Fall 2022-2023 (202201) contains 22 courses; minimum 15 SU credits required; minimum 5 courses required. Courses: CHEM 405 Electrochemistry, ECON 204 Microeconomics, ECON 323 Energy and Environmental Economics, ENRG 322 Battery Science and Engineering, ENRG 401 Energy: Supply Chain, Economics and Geopolitics, ENRG 420 Energy Systems Optimization, ENRG 422 Battery Science and Engineering, ENRG 423 Electric Power Systems: Operation, Technology and Economics, ENS 202 Thermodynamics, ENS 207 Introduction to Energy Systems, ENS 315 Energy, IF 401 Energy: Supply Chain, Economics and Geopolitics, MAT 204 Electrical, Optical and Magnetic Properties of Materials, MAT 309 Transport Phenomena in Materials Processing, ME 305 Power Electronics, ME 307 Fluid Dynamics, ME 309 Heat and Mass Transfer, ME 420 Renewable and Sustainable Energy Systems, ME 441 Advanced Vehicle Systems, NS 220 World Energy Outlook: The Coming Year, SPS 374 Global Environmental Challenges, SPS 384 Climate Change and Environmental Politics. Minimum 15 SU credits must be taken from the pool below. - At least one course must be taken from introductory courses pool.(ENS315, ENRG401 or IF401 or IR404, NS220) - At least one course must be taken from scientific fundamentals courses pool. (ENS 202, ENS 207) - At least one course must be taken from social, political and economic fundamentals courses pool. (ECON 204,ECON 412,SPS 384,ECON 323,SPS 374, ENRG 423 ) - At least one course must be taken from technology, systems and materials fundamentals courses pool. (ENRG 420,ENRG 322,MAT 204, MAT 309,ME 305,ME 307,ME 309,ME 420,ME 441,CHEM 405)
